title: dispatch hands each worker the operator id and the worker role, and its brief and record name them
goal: backlog.py dispatch starts each worker with KB_OPERATOR set to the dispatching operator's id and KB_ROLE=worker, whatever role the orchestrator has; the worker's brief names the operator id and the worker role; the dispatch record in the claims ledger holds the operator id and role beside the worker's pid and session

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, json, re
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree(".claude/hooks", os.path.join(C, ".claude", "hooks"))
for f in ("backlog.json", ".gitignore"):
    shutil.copy(f, C)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
shutil.copy("kb/_self/map.csv", os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "map.csv"))
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.makedirs(B)
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"  # built at run time: no address sits in the check's text
def stub(body):
    p = os.path.join(B, "claude"); open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\n" + body + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o755)
stub("echo '{\"loggedIn\": true, \"authMethod\": \"claude.ai\", \"email\": \"%s\"}'" % EM)
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(PATH=os.pathsep.join([B, os.path.dirname(shutil.which("git")), "/usr/bin", "/bin"]), HOME=T,
           GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def run(tool, *a, stdin=None, **kw):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, *tool.split("/")) if "/" in tool else os.path.join(C, "_tools", tool), *a],
                          cwd=C, env={**ENV, **kw}, input=stdin, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
O = dict(KB_OPERATOR="op-test0001", KB_ROLE="orchestrator")
r = run("backlog.py", "new", "sprint", "--title", "Planted", "--goal", "a planted goal", **O)
sp = re.search(r"new sprint (SP-\w+)", r.stdout).group(1)
run("backlog.py", "answer", sp, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator", **O)
r = run("backlog.py", "new", "story", "--title", "Planted dispatch", "--goal", "a planted dispatch", "--sprint", sp, "--touch", "kb/x.md",
        "--check", "python3 _tools/backlog.py config", **O)
s = re.search(r"new story (ST-\w+)", r.stdout).group(1)
run("backlog.py", "start", sp, **O)
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "plan")
r = run("backlog.py", "claim", s, "--by", "orch", "--commit", **O)
assert r.returncode == 0, ("claim fails", r.stderr[-300:])
r = run("backlog.py", "brief", s, **O)
assert r.returncode == 0, ("brief fails", r.stderr[-300:])
assert "op-test0001" in r.stdout and re.search(r"role\W+worker", r.stdout), ("the brief does not name the operator id and the worker role", r.stdout[:600])
EV = os.path.join(T, "worker-env.txt")
stub('printf "%%s %%s\\n" "$KB_OPERATOR" "$KB_ROLE" > %s; cat > /dev/null; echo \'{"type":"result","session_id":"s-planted","is_error":false,"result":"ok","num_turns":1}\'' % EV)
r = run("backlog.py", "dispatch", s, "--max-turns", "1", **O)
assert os.path.exists(EV), ("dispatch did not start the worker", r.returncode, r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-400:])
assert open(EV).read().split() == ["op-test0001", "worker"], ("the worker does not get KB_OPERATOR and KB_ROLE=worker", open(EV).read())
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(C, "_tools"))
import bl_dispatch
from pathlib import Path
rec = json.loads(bl_dispatch.ledger_path(Path(C)).read_text()).get(s) or {}
assert rec.get("operator") == "op-test0001" and rec.get("role") == "worker", ("the dispatch record does not name the operator and role", rec)
